quotes.speaker: Justin Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Justin Edwards on the support received from teammates and family
quotes.excerpt: It was like a little book of little messages from a couple of my teammates, family members and friends.
quotes.quote: It means a lot to me. Even for the teammates that wasn't there, they text me. It was actually it was like a little book of little messages from a couple of my teammates, family members and friends, so that was that was a cool experience.
quotes.social_post: Justin Edwards reflects on the support he received from his 76ers teammates and family, calling the messages he received a cool experience.

quotes.speaker: Justin Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Justin Edwards on team culture and supporting one another
quotes.excerpt: Just being together more, and also, you know, just had to make sure he was safe.
quotes.quote: That's one of the things we talked about is just being together more, and also, you know, just had to make sure he was safe, man. You know, at my high school, got to make sure he good in there. But on a serious note, just honestly just doing a little bit more stuff together, just showing up for each other.

quotes.speaker: Justin Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Justin Edwards on the personalities of teammates like Tyrese Maxey
quotes.excerpt: I didn't think Tyrese Maxey was that funny until I met him. He's actually a pretty funny guy.
quotes.quote: We all act alike in some similar forms. I didn't think Tyrese Maxey was that funny until I met him. He's actually a pretty funny guy. Brown is funny, so they all fit in pretty well with the team.
quotes.social_post: Justin Edwards admits he was surprised by Tyrese Maxey, saying I did not think Tyrese Maxey was that funny until I met him.

quotes.speaker: Justin Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Justin Edwards on his role in mentoring younger players
quotes.excerpt: Whatever rookie duties you got, make sure you do it, do it on time.
quotes.quote: Just honestly just tell them to just pay attention to the guy in front of you. And I'll tell them to just whatever rookie duties you got, make sure you do it, do it on time, so they won't pop on your car or anything. So I was a good rook, so I was just trying to help them a lot.
quotes.social_post: Justin Edwards shares his advice for the 76ers rookies, telling them to pay attention to the guy in front of you and make sure you do your rookie duties on time.

quotes.speaker: Justin Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Justin Edwards on the excitement of playing at MSG
quotes.excerpt: Stuff that you dream of as a kid. Honestly, I'm going to be super excited.
quotes.quote: Stuff that you dream of as a kid. Honestly, I'm going to be super excited. I'm pretty sure everybody else out here is going to be super excited. And just like I'm pretty sure we all remember what they did to us last year, so that's going to be something that's going to motivate us going into that game.
quotes.social_post: Justin Edwards says the 76ers are motivated for their upcoming game at MSG, noting that we all remember what they did to us last year.

quotes.speaker: Justin Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Justin Edwards on the challenge of defending Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: Seven-foot, big guy around the rim that don't really move. So you just got to try to figure.
quotes.quote: Seven-foot, big guy around the rim that don't really move. So you just got to try to figure out ways to get around him. And he's also like talking more, so it's just like when he's doing that and then he also contesting and getting on, so it's kind of hard to score around the rim.
quotes.social_post: Justin Edwards on the difficulty of scoring against Joel Embiid in practice, saying it is kind of hard to score around the rim when he is contesting and talking.

quotes.speaker: Justin Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Justin Edwards on learning from teammates and coaches
quotes.excerpt: They also tell me what to do and what not to do and stuff.
quotes.quote: Yes, they also tell me what to do and what not to do and stuff. So if I foul and I'm like, 'Hey, how was that a foul? What could I do better?' and they'll tell me. And then having Kenny on my team, he also tells me what to do and what not to do, so that helps me out too.
quotes.social_post: Justin Edwards credits his 76ers teammates and coaches for his development, saying they tell me what to do and what not to do when I have questions about fouls.
